summary: Ran the offline Node test suites for the SAP E-Bidding bot as instructed (no live SAP calls; WAF-blocked). Both suites passed cleanly: test-engine.js = 20/20, test-submit.js = 6/6. The primary regression under test — SEQUENTIAL captcha fetch/submit ordering — is confirmed: recorded event order is ['fetch','submit','fetch','submit'] (no clobbering pipeline). Hard captcha-lock backoff (single submit, no hammer) and bounded type-I retries (CAPTCHA_MAX_RETRY=3 then give up) both verified. Priority/batching (1164-first, single-first, club-atomic, club-2 top-up, 3-row cap), captcha store determinism (pool of 162, no random Redo), and IST :15/:45 -> UTC window math all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Sequential captcha submit path is correctly implemented in submitPlan(); prefetch-for-batch-1 optimization is preserved and covered by the 'prefetched captcha for batch1 skips its fetch' test.

Hard-lock detection message match ('Captcha Validation Failed'/'Contact Administrator') is string-based — consider a small helper isHardCaptchaLock(msg) to centralize the substring checks in case SAP tweaks wording.

CAPTCHA_MAX_RETRY is env-driven with a default of 3; the giving-up log line reads '4x' because it counts the initial attempt + 3 retries — cosmetic only, but could read 'gave up after N retries' for clarity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a Node.js CLI bot at /app/ebid, not a web app. Do NOT try to reach the live SAP host (WAF/IP-blocked -> 406). Verify only via `cd /app/ebid && node test/test-engine.js` (expect 20/0) and `node test/test-submit.js` (expect 6/0). Key regression to watch: event order in test-submit.js MUST be fetch,submit,fetch,submit — never fetch,fetch,submit,submit.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: submitPlan() prefetched captcha for batch N+1 in parallel with batch N's submit. SAP maintains ONE captcha per session, so the prefetch overwrote the captcha batch N was mid-submitting, causing 'Captcha Validation Failed. Please Contact Administrator.' hard locks. Fix (verified): make the loop strictly sequential — fetch captcha for batch K only after batch K-1's submit resolves; batch 1 may still use the pre-window prefetched captcha. Additionally, on hard-lock response, break out and back off (no retry storm), and cap type-I rejects at CAPTCHA_MAX_RETRY.
